notes.title: MotoGP™14 Season Pass available!
notes.content:
[h1]MotoGP™14 Season Pass available![/h1]
The complete set of [b]MotoGP™14 DLC[/b] is now available. Enhance your racing experience with exclusive download contents that will add more in-game feature! 

Can't make a decision? Buy the [b]MotoGP™14 Season Pass and have access to all the DLC contents released![/b]

Here's a list of the available DLC:
[list]
[*][b]MotoGP™14 Laguna Seca Red Bull US Grand Prix DLC [/b]
[*][b]MotoGP™14 Red Bull Rookies Cup DLC[/b]
[*][b]MotoGP™ 14 Donington Park Circuit DLC[/b]

notes.title: MotoGP™ 14 Donington Park Circuit DLC now available!
notes.content:
[h1]MotoGP™ 14 Donington Park Circuit DLC is now available![/h1]
Complete your racing experience with exclusive download contents that will add more in-game feature! 
[list]
[*][b]MotoGP™ 14 Donington Park Circuit DLC[/b]
[/list]
This new downloadable content adds the Donington Park British GP to your selectable tracks to Grand Prix, Championship – offline game modes – and all online modes, with the exception of Sprint Season.

notes.title: MotoGP™14 Red Bull Rookies Cup DLC now available!
notes.content:
[h1]MotoGP™14 Red Bull Rookies Cup DLC is now available on Steam™[/h1]
Complete your racing experience with exclusive download contents that will add more in-game feature! 
[list]
[*][b]MotoGP™14 Red Bull Rookies Cup DLC[/b]
[/list]
This new downloadable content adds a new category to the already existing ones and makes the Rookies Cup riders available in all game modes, except Career and Sprint Season.

notes.title: Available the first patch for MotoGP™14 Videogame
notes.content:
[h1]Milestone releases the first patch of MotoGP™14 Videogame[/h1]

The patch is available for all the videogame platforms and Steam™ users will download it automatically starting from today.

Here you can find the OFFICIAL CHANGELOG:

[*]Fixed tyre compound texture color
[*]Fixed AI qualification times
[*]Fixed winning picture in magazine 
[*]Fixed engine sound during free camera
[*]Fixed ideal trajectory toggle
[*]Fixed Safety Car skid marks and particles
[*]Improved Safety Car engine sound
